name: Webform Background Color
description: Adds a per-webform background color setting (a color picker) applied to selected webforms via a JS/CSS library.
project_description:
The webform_background_color module allows site administrators to assign a background color to selected Webforms. This is useful for visually distinguishing or theming individual forms on the frontend.

 To enable the color picker for a specific webform, navigate to /admin/config/webform/background-color and select the desired webform(s).

 To set the background color for a selected webform, click on Build, navigate to the Settings tab, choose your desired background color, and save the configuration.
